defects.rootCause: quickstart owned a second Number-based matcher and ad-hoc CSV parser
defects.resolution: quickstart now invokes the versioned reconciliation-core settlement engine and csv-parse

defects.rootCause: proof hash included export time and did not replay the decision set
defects.resolution: operational metadata is outside the committed payload; verifier recomputes the hash and reruns the engine

defects.rootCause: authenticated API and web demo contained legacy floating-point matching implementations
defects.resolution: hardened matching implementations to enforce integer minor-unit arithmetic with currency-specific exponents (USD/EUR 2, JPY 0, BHD/KWD 3) via @settler/reconciliation-core

defects.rootCause: Vercel configs permitted --no-frozen-lockfile fallback and deploy-production workflow did not gate on CI/E2E
defects.resolution: removed unfrozen install fallback across all vercel.json files, added /health and /api/v1/openapi.json endpoints to web, enforced required PRODUCTION_URL and deployed SHA verification in deploy-production.yml, and gated production domain promotion on successful CI and E2E workflow runs
